ads-funnel.title: Ad Funnel Architect
ads-funnel.audiencePlaceholder: B2B marketing managers at 50-500p SaaS, frustrated with their current attribution tool

errors.noSubject: Tell us what you're advertising — product/service name or landing URL or a connected client.
errors.aiNoResponse: AI provider didn't respond. Check Settings → AI provider and confirm a key is configured.
errors.aiUnparseable: AI returned a response we couldn't parse as JSON. Try again, or shorten your inputs.
errors.platformOmitted: (AI omitted this platform — re-run to get full coverage)

result.imagePromptsHint: Paste any of these into MidJourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, or a creative tool. Aspect ratio is encoded inline.

backlink-discovery.title: Backlink discovery
backlink-discovery.description: Free backlink finder for any domain, yours or a competitor's. Searches DuckDuckGo, then fetches each candidate page to confirm a real link and read its anchor text and follow status. Won't match Ahrefs's index — it finds dozens, not thousands — but every link it reports, it has read. No key, no quota.
backlink-discovery.help: Discovery runs three queries against DuckDuckGo, then fetches each candidate page to confirm a real '<'a href'>' and read its anchor text and rel. Up to 60 pages per run.
backlink-discovery.heading: Discovered links to {target}
backlink-discovery.empty: No candidates found. Try a more popular domain or skip crawl-to-confirm to widen the net.
backlink-discovery.noRel: No rel attribute, so it passes ranking signal

content-grader.title: Content grader
content-grader.description: Surfer / Clearscope replacement. Pulls the top-10 SERP results for your keyword, builds a TF-IDF corpus, then scores your draft on length and how much of what the ranking pages cover you actually cover. Keyword density is measured but deliberately not scored — it isn't a ranking factor. Free, no paid API.
content-grader.content: Your content (paste markdown or plain text)
content-grader.contentPlaceholder: # Best Vegan Cookbooks for Beginners\n\nIf you're new to plant-based cooking...
content-grader.help: We pull the top 10 SERP results, fetch each one's body text, compute TF-IDF, and score your draft against the corpus. Takes about 60-90 seconds.
content-grader.densityHigh: High enough to read as stuffed. Cut repetitions that don't earn their place.
content-grader.densityOk: Not scored. There's no density target to hit — cover the topic well and this takes care of itself.
content-grader.termCoverageHelp: Top terms across the SERP corpus. Bold = present in your draft.
content-grader.termTitle: Appears {count} times across the SERP corpus
content-grader.suggestedSectionsHelp: Headings used by 2+ top-ranking pages — strong signals of what searchers expect.

errors.content: Content must be at least 50 characters.
errors.emptyCorpus: Couldn't build a SERP corpus for this keyword.

facet-trap.title: Faceted-nav crawl-trap detector
facet-trap.description: Filter / sort / pagination params on category pages can balloon a crawl from thousands to millions of near-duplicate URLs. We crawl + group URLs by query shape and flag the ones that need canonical/noindex protection.
facet-trap.help: Crawls up to 60 pages from the homepage. Groups URLs by their query-string shape and classifies each group as filter / pagination / tracking / clean.
facet-trap.stats: {pages} pages scanned · {shapes} unique URL shapes · {facets} facet-shaped URLs found
facet-trap.groupsHelp: Sorted by risk severity, then by group size.

freshness.title: Freshness audit
freshness.description: AI-search systems (AI Overviews, Perplexity, ChatGPT) skip pages that look undated or stale. This audit fetches every freshness signal on your page — HTTP header, meta tags, JSON-LD dateModified, '<'time'>' elements, and visible 'Last updated' text — flags gaps and disagreements, and gives you a ready-to-paste JSON-LD + meta patch.
freshness.sitemapOptional: Optional: sitemap URL (to cross-check sitemap lastmod)
freshness.signalsSummary: {count, plural, one {# signal} other {# signals}} · newest is {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} old
freshness.signalsSummaryUndated: {count, plural, one {# signal} other {# signals}} · newest is undated
freshness.noSignals: No freshness signals detected at all. That's the worst case — AI search systems will treat this page as undated. Paste the patch below into '<'head'>'.
freshness.toFix: {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} to fix
freshness.patchHelp: Drops into '<'head'>'. Includes JSON-LD + visible text + article:modified_time meta. Update the headline and author placeholders before pasting.

fresh.headline: Fresh
fresh.body: Signals look recent. AI systems will treat this page as up-to-date.

aging.headline: Aging
aging.body: Signals are 3-12 months old. Consider a refresh — even a small update with a bumped dateModified helps.

stale.headline: Stale
stale.body: The newest signal is over a year old. AI-search systems will heavily downweight this page.

unknown.headline: Undated
unknown.body: No parseable freshness signal at all. AI-search systems can't tell how recent this content is.

geo-score.noteNoSignals: No blocking signals on the start URL
geo-score.summaryStrong: Strong GEO readiness ({composite}/100). Likely to surface in AI Overviews and answer engines — keep improving the weakest category.
geo-score.summaryMixed: Mixed GEO readiness ({composite}/100). Fix the lowest native GEO categories first (citability and technical access matter most).
geo-score.summaryWeak: Weak GEO readiness ({composite}/100). Improve passage structure, crawl access, and structured data before expecting AI citations.

github-pr.title: GitHub PR generator for SEO fixes
github-pr.description: For sites without a CMS write-bridge (Next.js, custom code, static sites), open a structured PR on GitHub with a checklist of SEO fixes for your developer to implement. Doesn't auto-edit application code — just lands the proposal.
github-pr.tokenLabel: GitHub Personal Access Token (scope: repo for private, public_repo otherwise)
github-pr.tokenNote: The PAT is sent only to GitHub; it’s not stored on the server.
github-pr.errorFieldsRequired: All fields except base branch are required.
github-pr.errorFixesNotArray: Fixes JSON must be an array.
github-pr.errorFixesInvalidJson: Fixes JSON is not valid JSON.

internal-linking.title: Internal linking suggester
internal-linking.description: Pick a target page + the keyword you're trying to rank it for. We crawl the site (sitemap + on-page links), find pages that mention the keyword in body text, and flag missing internal links you should add.
internal-linking.targetLabel: Target page URL (the page you want to rank)
internal-linking.found: Found {count} pages that mention “{keyword}” without linking to your target
internal-linking.empty: No pages found that mention this keyword. Either the keyword is very rare on your site or the sitemap is missing — try a related term.
internal-linking.suggestionsHelp: Pages that mention the keyword. Pages without an existing link to your target are listed first — those are your wins.

howTo.step1: Pick a page from “Missing link” — those are highest impact.
howTo.step2: Open the page, find the highlighted phrase, link it to your target URL.
howTo.step3: Use descriptive anchor text — the matched phrase usually works.
howTo.step4: Re-submit the edited page in GSC URL Inspection so Google re-crawls fast.

internal-linking.errorRequired: Both target URL and keyword required
internal-linking.findingTitle: {count, plural, one {# page could link to this one and does not} other {# pages could link to this one and do not}}
internal-linking.findingDetails: Pages on this site already mention "{keyword}" without linking to {targetUrl}. Internal links are the cheapest ranking signal there is — they need no outreach and no permission, and they tell Google which page is the one about this topic.

llms-txt.hintPlaceholder: e.g. main product is X, pricing page is at /pricing, blog is the most updated section
llms-txt.whereToPut: Where to put it: upload as /llms.txt at the root of your domain.
llms-txt.notPresent: This site has no llms.txt. That is not a problem in itself — the format is a proposal, not something Google has said it reads. Generate one above if you want assistants to have a curated summary of the site.
llms-txt.errorUnreachable: Couldn't reach the site to extract metadata.
llms-txt.errorAiNoResponse: AI provider didn't respond. Set up an API key in Settings.
llms-txt.issueNoH1: Missing top-level H1 (single # line at the start).
llms-txt.issueNoSummary: Missing blockquote with the one-sentence value prop.
llms-txt.issueTooLong: File is {length} chars — most parsers expect ≤ 2000.
llms-txt.issueTooShort: File looks too short — add a description and key links.
llms-txt.findingNoH1Details: The single # line is how a parser learns whose site this is. Without it the file reads as a fragment rather than a directory.
llms-txt.findingNoSummaryDetails: The blockquote is the sentence an assistant is most likely to repeat when asked what this site is. Leaving it out means the model writes its own.
llms-txt.findingTooLongTitle: llms.txt is longer than parsers expect
llms-txt.findingTooLongDetails: The file is {length} characters and most parsers expect 2000 or fewer. Anything past the limit may simply not be read.
llms-txt.findingTooShortDetails: The file exists, which tells an assistant to read it, and then says nothing — which is worse than not having one, because it looks deliberate.

local-cwv.title: Local Core Web Vitals (no PSI key)
local-cwv.description: Renders any URL in headless Chrome, measures LCP / FCP / CLS / TBT / TTFB directly from the PerformanceObserver, and computes a Lighthouse-equivalent 0-100 score. No PageSpeed key, no API quota — just runs locally on demand.
local-cwv.modeHelp: PSI is Google's PageSpeed Insights API — fast, and it reads real-user data where Google has it. Without your own key it shares one small daily allowance with every install of this app, so it runs out; when it does, this falls back to the local browser automatically. Local runs headless Chrome on this machine: slower, no quota, and it catches console errors PSI cannot see.
local-cwv.fellBackNote: These are synthetic numbers from one run here, not real-user data from Google.
local-cwv.consoleErrors: {count, plural, one {# console error} other {# console errors}} during page load

mobile-friendly.title: Mobile-friendly checker
mobile-friendly.description: Google deprecated their public Mobile-Friendly Test in 2023. We replaced it. Checks viewport tag, charset, responsive images, fixed-width elements, tap-target sizes, intrusive interstitials. No PSI key.

schema-validate.title: Schema validator (live URL)
schema-validate.description: Paste any URL — we extract every JSON-LD block and validate it. Catches missing required fields, invalid JSON, missing canonical, type-specific pitfalls (dateModified, priceCurrency, etc). Always cross-check with Google's Rich Results Test before shipping.
schema-validate.noBlocks: No JSON-LD blocks found on this page. Add a tag in .

findings.noneTitle: No structured data on this page
findings.noneDetails: No JSON-LD blocks found. Schema is what makes a result eligible for the richer listings — review stars, FAQ dropdowns, product prices — rather than a plain link.
findings.errorsTitle: {count, plural, one {# structured-data block has errors} other {# structured-data blocks have errors}}
findings.errorsDetails: . Google ignores a block it cannot parse, so this markup is currently doing nothing.
findings.warningsTitle: {count, plural, one {# block missing recommended fields} other {# blocks missing recommended fields}}
findings.warningsDetails: . These are valid but incomplete — Google will use them and show less.

schema.title: Schema markup generator
schema.intro: Pick a type, paste your URL — AI fills the rest using site metadata we auto-extract. Output: valid JSON-LD ready to paste into your .
schema.notesPlaceholder: e.g. published date 2024-08-15, author Jane Doe, price $29.99 USD
schema.howToUse: How to use: wrap this in and paste into the page's . Validate at Google's Rich Results Test.
schema.errorNoAi: AI provider didn't respond. Set up an API key in Settings.

summarizer.title: AI content summarizer
summarizer.description: Paste content (or pull from URL). AI returns a TL;DR, 5-7 key takeaways, a 150-160 char meta description, and a tweetable quote. Same as Yoast Premium AI Summarize, free in our tool.

sxo.title: SXO — Search Experience Optimization
sxo.description: Audits ranking pages on the user-experience signals Google now weights heavily: page promise, time-to-answer, next step, friction, Core Web Vitals. Blends SEO with UX.

notes.noDirectAnswer: Doesn't open with a direct answer.
notes.noCta: No clear CTA — dead-end page risk.

friction.cookieBanner: Cookie banner likely covers initial viewport
friction.popup: Pop-up / modal markup present — verify it isn't on initial load
friction.newsletter: Newsletter signup detected — common dwell-time killer when interstitial
friction.adSlots: {count} ad slots detected — heavy ads correlate with pogo-sticking
friction.noCta: No clear action button detected — users have no obvious next step

defaultRecommendations.directOpening: Open the page with a direct definition or value statement.
defaultRecommendations.visibleCta: Ensure at least one prominent CTA is visible in the first viewport.
defaultRecommendations.interstitials: Remove or delay non-essential interstitials (cookies, popups).

findings.promiseUnclear: Page promise is unclear — missing or weak H1
findings.ttaSlow: Slow time-to-answer — readers wait for the point
findings.nextStepClear: Clear next step on the page
findings.nextStepMissing: No clear next step — dead-end risk
findings.frictionDetails: Detected on initial page render — verify it isn't blocking the above-the-fold experience.
findings.cwvPoor: Poor Core Web Vitals — speed is hurting rankings

traffic-drop.title: Why did my traffic drop?
traffic-drop.description: Pulls last 28 days vs the 28 days before that from GSC. Diffs queries, pages, impressions. Cross-references curated Google algorithm-update timeline. AI ranks the most likely cause and writes 3-4 verification steps.
traffic-drop.setupTitle: Connect Google Search Console to use this
traffic-drop.setupDetail: Diagnosing a drop means comparing the last 28 days of queries and pages against the 28 before, which comes from Search Console.

utm-attribution.title: Multi-touch attribution (UTM-based)
utm-attribution.description: Compute first-touch, last-touch, assisted, linear, and position-based attribution from UTM-tagged touch data. No CRM needed — works with GA4 export, Mixpanel, or any CSV with userId / source / medium / campaign columns.
utm-attribution.pasteLabel: Paste touch data (CSV with header row recommended)
utm-attribution.compareModels: Compare models — first-touch and last-touch tell different stories. Linear and position-based are the most balanced.
